title: Collin

our_entries.enemy_kind: Enemy hooligan in Highroad Hijinx (wiki). The client holds a "NewbieZone Collin" flag grant (279606014) and the speech "Oy! What did you chumps do to Collin?" (3590798864).

client_cluster: locale:38364 [quest_title | Sacred Grove | A Pinch of Choy] 'A Pinch of Choy'

locale:38365 [quest_dialog | Sacred Grove | A Pinch of Choy] "There's still something missing from my recipe.

Hmm... I got it! Choychoy! You want to help me make history?

Bring me four"
locale:38366 [quest_dialog | Sacred Grove | A Pinch of Choy] 'Funnel needs four choychoy to finish off his drink and you are the lucky harvester he has chosen to obtain it for him!'
locale:38367 [quest_objective | Sacred Grove | A Pinch of Choy] 'Harvest choychoy'
locale:38370 [quest_dialog | Sacred Grove | A Pinch of Choy] 'I really need those four choychoy when you have time. I want my creation to be just perfect!'

locale:38374 [quest_dialog | Lakeshore | Taste Test] "I made some relished choychoy for my friend, <font color='#d9781a'>Merri De'Flor</font> in <font color='#d9781a'>Lakeshore</font>, but I really don't have time "
locale:38376 [quest_dialog | Lakeshore | Taste Test] "Dahlia made some relished choychoy for her friend, Merri De'Flor in Lakeshore and has asked you to deliver it to her."
locale:38377 [quest_objective | Lakeshore | Taste Test] "Deliver the relished choychoy to Merri De'Flor"
locale:38378 [quest_objective | Lakeshore | Taste Test] " Deliver the relished choychoy to Merri De'Flor in Lakeshore."
locale:38379 [quest_dialog | Lakeshore | Taste Test] "Please hurry and deliver that relished choychoy to Merri De'Flor in Lakeshore. I don't want it to get cold. Thanks!"

locale:38380 [quest_dialog | Lakeshore | Taste Test] "Relished choychoy? Sounds weird, but here goes! Munch! Mmm... it's sweet... and tangy... and delicious! If you see her again, tell her I want the recipe!"
